Native paired-bootstrap simultaneous FPCR slope bands on the observed grid

etr_native_fpcr_slope_source_calibration.Rd

Pure native R postcalibration of an existing paired-bootstrap Gaussian FPCR slope array. Uses studentized maximum absolute bootstrap deviations with a global time-by-dimension maximum or separate per-dimension time maxima.

Usage

etr_fpca_regression_slope_simultaneous_band(
  result, confidence_level = 0.95, simultaneous_scope = "global")

Arguments

result

Native scientific fit record with finite reference slope matrix, finite B-by-time-by-dimension bootstrap slope array, and source FPCA dimension identifiers.

confidence_level

Numeric probability strictly between zero and one.

simultaneous_scope

One of "global" or "dimension".

Value

A scientific R record with reference-grid lower and upper bounds, pointwise bootstrap standard errors, source-calibrated maximum absolute studentized statistics, and critical values. Return class is not equivalent to Python's dataclass.

Details

The postcalibration matches the frozen Python 1.2.0 fpca_regression_slope_simultaneous_band observed-grid procedure. Sample bootstrap standard deviations (ddof=1) and NumPy method="higher" quantiles are retained. Material nonzero reference discrepancies with effectively zero bootstrap standard error are rejected. No regression fit, basis, or bootstrap data are recomputed. Continuous-domain coverage, operator-scaled FPCR significance tests, and full source-contract equivalence are not claimed or independently certified.
